# thelake

> Cost-effective long-term AI and application evidence lake. End-to-end session tracing with full payloads, built on DuckDB and DuckLake.

thelake is an Apache-2.0 Rust runtime: OTLP traces and logs in; DuckLake + Zstd Parquet sorted by `session_id` on object store or disk; DuckDB SQL and Grafana-compatible Loki/Tempo query APIs out. Instead of sampled real-time APM monitoring, thelake preserves every turn, span, prompt, tool call, and HTTP body in a session for investigation, evaluation, and regression testing. Softprobe Blackbox is built on thelake.

## Site

- [API docs (Swagger)](https://thelake.softprobe.ai/swagger): HTTP API reference
- [GitHub](https://github.com/softprobe/thelake): Source, README, License.txt
- [Softprobe](https://www.softprobe.ai/): Commercial Blackbox product powered by thelake
